source: NOAA RRFS ensemble member public subset (prslevnomads + 2dfldnomads, 3 km CONUS GRIB2)

companion.source: NOAA RRFS deterministic CONUS prslev + 2dfld GRIB2 product pair
companion.cycle: the member's own cycle, at every valid time the member supplies
companion.decoded_by: the packaged deterministic RRFS mapping, pinned by SHA-256 in the composition
supplies: air_temperature, specific_humidity, eastward_wind, northward_wind and geopotential_height at every level above the member's 250 hPa top (14 levels, 200 to 2 hPa), stacked onto the member's own columns
skin_temperature, land_fraction, sea_ice_fraction, snow_water_equivalent and snow_depth
soil_temperature and volumetric_soil_moisture on the nine RUC nodes
companion.why: the public member subset stops at 250 hPa and publishes no soil, skin temperature or land mask

member_supplies: air_temperature, specific_humidity, eastward_wind, northward_wind and geopotential_height on its 14 levels from 250 to 1000 hPa; surface pressure, terrain, 2 m temperature and dewpoint, 10 m wind
time_policy: the member's own terrain, decoded at every valid time from its 2dfldnomads file and required invariant
member_policy: member identity is the product's own (product definition template 1), verified separately against the rw-wps.members.v1 grammar; the composition receipt names the member and the companion
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
